definitions.explanation: A public official who presides over court proceedings and makes legal decisions.

examples.japanese: {判事|はんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}した→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{判事|はんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}された→任命する：noentry⟧。
examples.english: She was appointed as a Supreme Court justice.

examples.japanese: {判事|はんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{司法|しほう}→司法：noentry⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}しなければならない→合格する：02816_goukaku⟧。
examples.english: To become a judge, you must pass the bar examination.

notes:
{判事|はんじ} refers specifically to judges in the court system.

Related terms:
- ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧ (judge - more formal/official term)
- ⟦{裁判長|さいばんちょう}→裁判長：noentry⟧ (presiding judge)
- ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧ (lawyer, attorney)
- ⟦{検察官|けんさつかん}→検察官：noentry⟧ (prosecutor)

Common collocations:
- {判事|はんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a judge)
- {判事|はんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as a judge)

Note: In everyday conversation, {判事|はんじ} and ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧ are often used interchangeably, though ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧ is the more official legal term.
